summary_en: 5,000,000 shares (0.8% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) | ¥671M upper limit | price ceiling not disclosed | open-market purchase | execution window Aug 10–Nov 12, 2026 | stated reason: employee share grants and capital efficiency
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: UT Group Co., Ltd. announced on 7 August 2026 that its Board of Directors has resolved to acquire up to 5,000,000 treasury shares (0.8% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥671 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 10 August 2026 and 12 November 2026. The stated rationale is to support human capital investment through employee share grants and to improve capital efficiency as part of building a sustainable growth foundation. No price ceiling per share has been disclosed. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 7,732,635 treasury shares, with an additional 24,502,600 shares held by the employee share grant trust (which are excluded from the treasury share count).
